gmail_search_query: subject:(application OR applying OR resume) newer_than:7d

screener_questions.question: Have you done outbound cold calling before? For how long?
What hours can you work in US Eastern time?

templates.indeed: Hey {first_name}, thanks for applying for the {role} role. Quick next step: can you send a 1-2 minute video introducing yourself and telling me about your phone sales experience? A phone selfie video is perfect, nothing fancy.
templates.gmail: Hey {first_name}, got your application for the {role} role, thanks for reaching out. Next step is a quick 1-2 minute intro video: who you are, your experience, and why this role. Reply with a link or attachment whenever you can.
templates.facebook: Hey {first_name}, saw your reply on the {role} post. Next step is quick: send me a 1-2 minute video introducing yourself and your experience. A phone video is perfect.
